sql:
SELECT 
    sod.productid,
    SUM(sod.orderqty) AS total_quantity_ordered,
    MAX(sop.discountpct) AS discount_percentage
FROM 
    sales.salesorderdetail sod
JOIN 
    sales.specialofferproduct sop ON sod.productid = sop.productid
GROUP BY 
    sod.productid;
